annotations.title: ETFs, ETCs and ETNs listed on GPW

description: List of all ETFs, ETCs and ETNs listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (GPW), with asset class, index, ongoing cost (TER) from the KID, distribution policy, replication and provider, each with a link to the KID. Filters: name/ticker/ISIN, asset class (equity, government bonds, corporate bonds, commodities, crypto), type, provider, maximum cost. listing="outside_gpw" lists selected large corporate bond UCITS ETFs not listed on GPW (there is no corporate bond ETF on GPW). No prices or yields. Lista ETF/ETC/ETN z GPW z kosztem, indeksem i replikacją.

asset_class.description: equity, government bonds, corporate bonds, bonds (all bond classes), commodities, crypto. Polish labels also accepted.

listing.description: gpw (default) = listed on GPW; outside_gpw = selected corporate bond ETFs listed abroad; all = both.

max_cost.description: Maximum ongoing cost in % per year, e.g. "0.5".

query.description: Part of name, ticker, ISIN, index or provider, e.g. "WIG20", "Beta", "S&P 500".
